**Day 1: Upper Body and Core**

* Chair squats (10 reps x 3 sets)
* Plank hold (30-60 seconds)

**Day 2: Lower Body and Core**

* Warm-up: Seated leg raises (10 reps x 3 sets)
* Chair squats (15 reps x 3 sets)
* Wall push-ups (12 reps x 3 sets)
* Russian twists (sitting on floor with knees bent, twisting torso to left and right) (10 reps x 3 sets per side)

**Day 3: Full Body**

* Warm-up: Seated leg raises (10 reps x 3 sets)
* Chair squats (15 reps x 3 sets)
* Wall push-ups (12 reps x 3 sets)
* Plank hold (30-60 seconds)
* Bicycle crunches (lying on back with hands behind head, alternating bringing elbow to opposite knee) (10 reps x 3 sets)

Remember to listen to your body and adjust the routine as needed. If you experience any pain or discomfort, stop immediately and consult a professional!
